Idris Okoya, son of Nigerian billionaire industrialist and Eleganza Group chairman, Razaq Okoya, has married a woman identified as Rukoyah.
Shade Okoya, wife of the industrialist, congratulated the couple in an Instagram Story on Monday, sharing a photograph of the newlyweds with the caption, “Congratulations to the newest couple @idrisokoya.”
Shade was also spotted in a video from the wedding, dressed in aso ebi worn for the occasion.
A food vendor, Tuwo Pama International, also shared a video from the private ceremony on Sunday, offering prayers for the couple.
“Today’s event at Rukoyah and Idris Okoya’s wedding. May Almighty Allah bless their union,” the vendor wrote.
Idris is one of Razaq Okoya’s sons from an earlier marriage. His father is known for founding the Eleganza Group, a Nigerian conglomerate with interests in manufacturing and other businesses.
